brief.t: START HERE: Pull the Polo 4PL invoice for container EMCU8614105, verify whether it has been paid, and send the receipt so clearance can begin.

ACT NOW 1: Container EMCU8614105 is blocked from duties, tax payment, and release until PLL confirms the Polo 4PL invoice payment and sends the receipt. 4PL Accounting is waiting; 0 days overdue by a stated deadline. Send: Erik, I am confirming the invoice payment and will send the receipt. Please confirm clearance and the pickup ETA once duties are paid.

ACT NOW 2: Kenna's Et-VC package was reported delivered to PLL on September 16, but forwarding status remains unanswered after the October 2 follow-up. Mel is waiting; 0 days overdue by a stated deadline and 17 calendar days have elapsed since reported arrival. Send: Mel, I am locating the Et-VC package and will send the forwarding tracking and status today.

ACT NOW 3: FSS order 162946 is paid, and the supplier offered to expedite it Monday, October 5, but no ship or delivery date is confirmed. PLL is waiting on the raw material; 0 days overdue. Send: Phillip, please confirm Monday's expedited dispatch and send tracking.

next: Recommendation: Resolve the Polo 4PL invoice first because the container cannot advance to clearance or release without the payment receipt.
Scheduled: 4 dated items surfaced. The nearest is a Sam-owned agreement reply due October 4; the next Aidan-side supplier milestone is the FSS expedite on October 5.

Noise: 71 unique Outlook items surfaced and 37 unread hits were returned; the exact noise count is unavailable because Outlook did not return a total and results include routine and sent-thread items.

Source gaps: CRM browser session signed out. WhatsApp Web signed out. Purchasing accepted the request but did not reply within 10 minutes. Email replied with no substantive drafts or overdue dated commitments.
signal: Polo 4PL container release, Kenna package forwarding, and FSS raw-material dispatch are today's clearest operational and revenue-protection signals.
